question_text: Which demo booth attracted bigger crowds — NVIDIA or Intel? Roughly how much more popular was the winner?

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.camera_location CONTAINS 'NVIDIA'
    AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN
    'NVIDIA' AS booth,
    coalesce(sum(ch.event_count), 0) AS total_samples,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(sum(ch.event_count), 0) > 0 THEN toFloat(sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count)) / coalesce(sum(ch.event_count), 0) ELSE NULL END AS weighted_avg_hc,
    max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_hc
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.camera_location CONTAINS 'Intel'
    AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN
    'Intel' AS booth,
    coalesce(sum(ch.event_count), 0) AS total_samples,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(sum(ch.event_count), 0) > 0 THEN toFloat(sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count)) / coalesce(sum(ch.event_count), 0) ELSE NULL END AS weighted_avg_hc,
    max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_hc
}
RETURN booth, total_samples, weighted_avg_hc, peak_hc
ORDER BY total_samples DESC
